name: Onoue Nozomu
source:
[url=/c115863]Nodoka[/url]'s childhood friend and classmate, a second-year student, and the student council's vice president.

An earnest person who is good at both sports and studies. Because of his efforts, he always stays at the top of his class. Although he is somewhat popular, he has no interest in romance, and never had a girlfriend.

He isn't the type of person who has a strong obsession​ with winning or losing, but always goes along with Nodoka.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Hbattle/#chara]Official website[/url]]
